title: Native app wrappers
description: Capacitor iOS and Android builds of the web app.

title: Tournaments and ratings
description: Swiss or knockout events with ratings.

title: Crowd play
description: A streamer's audience votes on each move for a seat.

title: Endless board
description: Unbounded board for a fixed number of rounds; PixiJS canvas with pan and zoom.

title: Daily puzzle
description: Seeded partly filled board: place your last moves for the best score; shareable result grid; D1 leaderboard, Worker cron.

title: Objectives: secret pattern cards
description: Private hands of pattern goals (L, 2x2, diagonal of 5) for extra points; server hides hands.

title: Teams variant
description: 2v2 or 3v3 with shared runs across teammates' marks.

title: Terrain variant
description: Blocked cells and double-value cells; fairness counts playable cells.

title: Flip variant
description: Bracketing exactly two enemy marks in a line converts them.

title: Gravity variant
description: Marks drop to the lowest empty cell of a column, Connect Four style.

title: Fog: simultaneous secret turns
description: Everyone places at once; clashing cells become blocked; server-side commit and reveal.

title: Torus (wrap-around) variant
description: Edges wrap so every line is full length.

title: Hex board variant
description: Hexagonal cells, three directions, SVG rendering.

title: Tiers: three linked levels (3D-chess style)
description: Three flat R x C levels with pillars and 8 ramp directions as 3-cell cross-level lines, tier bonus, side-by-side or CSS-perspective stack; options: offset levels, elevators, more levels. Owner 2026-09-23: "I don't think I'd want full 3D in terms of solid objects, but I can envision something intriguing with three separated but connected levels providing 3d gameplay - like 3d chess."

title: Phase 5+: variants
description: Variant catalogue in GDD section 11, built on the topology abstraction (cells plus scoring lines). Owner 2026-09-23: "I like all your ideas ... Keep all of your ideas as roadmap possibilities in the GDD. Add more if they come to mind."

title: Phase 4: smarter play
description: Planner bot (MCTS) in Rust/WASM, Coach heatmap hints, TV mode. GDD sections 6 and 11.

title: Phase 3: accounts, async play and stats
description: Passkeys and magic links (Better Auth on D1), async rooms with push notifications, cross-device history, stats, share images, interactive tutorial. GDD sections 6 and 9.

title: Phase 2: online multiplayer core
description: Owner 2026-09-23: "regular online server multiplayer is definitely meant to be core. This game was never quite finished." Rooms with codes and links, lobby, live ghost marks, reconnection, disconnect handling with bot takeover, spectators, rematch, reactions, presets, animated results, replay. Cloudflare Durable Objects via PartyServer; server-authoritative engine. GDD sections 6 and 10.
acceptance_criteria: Two browsers play a full online game including a disconnect and reconnect; the server rejects illegal actions.

title: Installable offline PWA
description: Service worker and manifest so pass-and-play works offline.
acceptance_criteria: The installed app starts and plays a full local game offline.

title: Scatter and Greedy bots
description: Bots in a Web Worker: Scatter (random) and Greedy (maximum immediate gain, blocking larger rival gains). GDD section 6.
acceptance_criteria: A solo game against Greedy completes without blocking the UI on a 30x30 board.

title: Fix legacy defects during port
description: Found in agent review 2026-09-23 of src/: storeDirectionArrays saves the store object, not its value (src/stores.js); ToggleAutoFillFinalTurn writes the theme key, so autofill always runs; the finalturn event only logs (finalTurnTally in src/routes/tictactoe.svelte), so completed games score only after reload; subscriptions and resize listeners are never cleaned up; tickThis parses row/col from id[1]/id[3], wrong for 10+ rows or columns; scoring re-parses localStorage per cell (quadratic).
acceptance_criteria: Each defect has a regression check or is structurally impossible in the new engine.

title: Reload-safe saving, export and import
description: Single versioned game record persisted on every placement; finished-game history in IndexedDB; .sttt.json export/import (completes the legacy unimplemented Save/Load).
acceptance_criteria: Reload mid-turn restores pending marks; an exported file re-imports to an identical board and scores.

title: Game screen, setup and scoreboard port
description: Port board, status bar, scoreboard with direction breakdown, sentence-style setup with both methods (board first / pace first), player name/mark/colour editing, themes, results tally. Layout per GDD 7-8; CSS container queries for cell sizing; native dialog; emoji-picker-element.
acceptance_criteria: A 2-player 8x12 game plays to completion on desktop and phone portrait with keyboard and touch; results show per-direction totals.

title: SvelteKit app scaffold, tooling and CI
description: SvelteKit 2.70 + Svelte 5 + Vite 8 + TS strict, pnpm workspace (packages/engine, apps/web), adapter-static, Vitest, Playwright, axe, GitHub Actions. Retire Sapper, Rollup, node-sass and Cypress.
acceptance_criteria: install, check, test, build and e2e pass locally and in CI on Node 24.

title: Rules engine with characterisation tests
description: packages/engine: flat Int8Array board, precomputed lines per direction with bonus values, place/takeBack/endTurn, final-turn fill, scoring, fair-configuration maths, game record. Legacy score() from src/components/CountPoints.svelte kept verbatim as a test oracle; fast-check property tests (fairness, mirror invariance).
acceptance_criteria: Engine matches the oracle on thousands of random boards, including rectangular partial-bonus cases (8x14, B=12 gives column and diagonal bonus 7).

title: Phase 1: faithful port to SvelteKit 2 + Svelte 5
description: Rebuild the legacy Sapper app (src/) with identical rules and look, fixing known defects. GDD sections 2-4, 7-10, 11. Owner 2026-09-23: "The first order of busines though will be a faithful port to modern/current Sveltekit."
acceptance_criteria: Local pass-and-play game playable end to end; scores match legacy score() on the characterisation suite; reload resumes exactly; static build deploys.

title: Owner decisions pending in GDD section 12
description: Open questions in docs/GDD.md section 12: End turn confirmation vs auto-end default; Live score default; timer overflow placement (random vs Greedy bot); 30x30 max board; name/brand vs Ultimate tic-tac-toe; Cloudflare as sole host; async games without account; monetisation. A doc comment asks about the End turn default. These are proposals, not decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Each question answered by the owner and recorded in the GDD decisions table.

title: Game design document
description: Complete GDD for Super Tic-Tac-Toe: rules, scoring, fair configuration, modes, UX, presentation, persistence, architecture, roadmap, decisions. Living doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/d72fe939-63a3-4f00-91dd-cd0cb7417f1a; repo snapshot docs/GDD.md. Owner 2026-09-23: "produce the complete GDD - length and verbosity are not our goals in this, but comprehensive feature coverage and a lucid explanation/description of the game is."
acceptance_criteria: GDD covers all features and roadmap ideas; exported to docs/GDD.md.
close_reason: GDD written in the living doc and exported to docs/GDD.md on 2026-09-23.

Source: owner request 2026-09-23: "Pull in ...agentic-operations-improvement and make your first commit here with the new GDD"; owner then said to use the GitHub remote.
